learning_goals: Understand, analyse, and implement gradient-based optimisation methods used in mechanical-engineering computation.
Connect convergence assumptions to algorithm choice and implementation diagnostics.
target_depth: A rigorous second-year introduction with formulas, theorem scope, algorithm comparisons, and implementation bridges.
proof_depth: Explain the meaning and hypotheses of results without full proofs; show enough reasoning to connect models to updates.
assumptions_requiring_review: Unconstrained objective notation is used unless stated otherwise
Examples are pedagogical surrogates rather than engineering guarantees
